event_archive_frontier_begin_rewrite_tes:
"""Actual BEGIN owns named MK initialization, with exact child/core threading."""
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import lisp_rewrite as lr
import event_archive_fixed_rows_rewrite as fixed
import event_archive_frontier_begin_rewrite as rw
import event_archive_member_rewrite as member
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def read(p):return (ROOT/p).read_text()
def one(s,p):return lr.match(p,lr.parse(s).forms)[0].node
class Begin(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_checked_class_replay_and_idempotence(self):
  for name,fn,patterns in [
   ('cursor',rw.cursor,['(fn2-event-archive-operation (fn2-event-archive-cold-cursor-begin ?*args) ?*body)']),
   ('boot',rw.boot,['(defcost fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-begin ?*body)','(defun fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-begin ?*body)'])]:
   before=read('tools/fixtures/event-archive-cold-'+name+'-before-frontier.lisp');after=fn(before)
   after=fixed.rewrite(member.cursor(after) if name=='cursor' else after)
   self.assertEqual(fn(after),after)
   current=read('books/event-archive-cold-'+name+'.lisp')
   for pattern in patterns:
    a=one(after,pattern);b=one(current,pattern)
    self.assertEqual(after[a.start:a.end],current[b.start:b.end])
 def test_private_row_ready_before_real_initialization(self):
  s=read('books/event-archive-cold-cursor.lisp')
  f=one(s,'(fn2-event-archive-operation (fn2-event-archive-cold-cursor-begin ?*args) ?*body)')
  self.assertEqual(len(lr.match('(fn2-mk-init event-row fn2-mk)',[f])),1)
  for p in ['(event-row (fn2-b-event-row (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc)))','(< 0 event-row)',
            '(fn2-mk-ready event-row fn2-mk fn2-digests)','(fn2-b3-ready event-row fn2-b3 fn2-digests)']:
   self.assertTrue(lr.match(p,[f]),p)
  init=lr.match('(fn2-mk-init event-row fn2-mk)',[f])[0].node
  root=lr.match('(fn2-event-archive-cold-start-root ?*args)',[f])[0].node
  self.assertLess(init.start,root.start)
  self.assertFalse(lr.match('(fn2-mk-init 0 fn2-mk)',[f]))
 def test_actual_core_constructor_receives_all_mutable_outputs(self):
  s=read('books/event-archive-cold-boot.lisp');f=one(s,'(defun fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-begin ?*body)')
  view=lr.match('(stobj-let ?*body)',[f])[0].node
  self.assertIn('fn2-mk',[n.low for n in view.items[2].items])
  call=lr.match('(fn2-event-archive-cold-cursor-begin ?*args)',[f])[0].node
  self.assertEqual([n.low for n in call.items[-3:]],rw.EXTRA)
if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
event_archive_visit_rewrite_test.py:
"""Same concrete restart-byte formula and exact operation/face cost replay."""
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import lisp_rewrite as lr
import event_archive_fixed_rows_rewrite as fixed
import event_archive_visit_rewrite as rw
import event_archive_member_rewrite as member
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def read(p):return (ROOT/p).read_text()
def form(s,p):
 n=lr.match(p,lr.parse(s).forms)[0].node
 return s[n.start:n.end]
class Visit(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_operation_template_replay_and_idempotence(self):
  old=read('tools/fixtures/archive-visit-before-event-archive-producer.lisp');after=rw.operation(old)
  self.assertEqual(form(after,'(defmacro fn2-event-archive-operation ?*args)'),form(read('books/event-archive-producer.lisp'),'(defmacro fn2-event-archive-operation ?*args)'))
  self.assertEqual(rw.operation(after),after)
  self.assertIn("(bytes (if costp (cadar body) '(* 2 *fn2-run-layout-max-entry-bytes*)))",after)
 def test_same_actual_formula_and_envelope_premises(self):
  old=read('tools/fixtures/archive-visit-before-checkpoint-restore-semantic-work.lisp')
  f=form(old,'(defconst *fn2-checkpoint-restore-semantic-entry-bytes* ?value)')
  shared=read('books/run-entry-work.lisp')
  self.assertEqual(f.replace('*fn2-checkpoint-restore-semantic-entry-bytes*','*fn2-run-entry-visit-bytes*'),form(shared,'(defconst *fn2-run-entry-visit-bytes* ?value)'))
  for p in ['(assert-event (<= *fn2-run-layout-max-entry-bytes* *fn2-format-page-size*))',
            '(assert-event (<= (+ (* 2 *fn2-run-entries-base*) *fn2-run-restart-bytes* 32) (* 2 *fn2-format-page-size*)))',
            '(assert-event (<= *fn2-run-entry-visit-bytes* *fn2-checkpoint-semantic-visit-bytes*))']:
   self.assertTrue(lr.match(p,lr.parse(shared).forms),p)
  s=read('books/checkpoint-restore-semantic-work.lisp')
  self.assertIn('(defconst *fn2-checkpoint-restore-semantic-entry-bytes* *fn2-run-entry-visit-bytes*)',s)
 def test_check_child_and_both_actual_core_faces_use_same_cost(self):
  old=read('tools/fixtures/archive-visit-before-event-archive-cold-boot.lisp')
  names=['fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-check-raw','fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-check']
  current=read('books/event-archive-cold-boot.lisp');after=rw.explicit(old,names)
  self.assertEqual(fixed.rewrite(member.boot(after)),current);self.assertEqual(rw.explicit(after,names),after)
  for path,name in [('event-archive-cold-cursor','fn2-event-archive-cold-cursor-step'),('event-archive-cold-reach','fn2-event-archive-cold-step-reach')]:
   s=read('books/'+path+'.lisp');n=lr.match('(fn2-event-archive-operation '+name+' ?*body)',lr.parse(s).forms)[0].node
   self.assertEqual(s[n.items[4].start:n.items[4].end],'(:bytes *fn2-run-entry-visit-bytes*)')
   before=read('tools/fixtures/archive-visit-before-'+path+'.lisp');before=fixed.rewrite(member.cursor(before) if path=='event-archive-cold-cursor' else before);beforeform=form(before,'(fn2-event-archive-operation '+name+' ?*body)')
   restored=lr.write(s,[(n.items[4].start,n.items[4].end+1,'')])
   # Byte-cost directive alone must leave the actual implementation AST identical.
   norm=lambda x:lr.flat(lr.parse(x).forms[0])
   self.assertEqual(norm(form(restored,'(fn2-event-archive-operation '+name+' ?*body)')),norm(beforeform))
if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
event_archive_reach_bind_rewrite_test.py:
"""Exact boot-face class threading and authenticated cold page claims."""
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import lisp_rewrite as lr
import event_archive_reach_bind_rewrite as rw
import event_archive_frontier_begin_rewrite as frontier
import event_archive_visit_rewrite as visit
import event_archive_member_rewrite as member
import event_archive_fixed_rows_rewrite as fixed
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def read(p):return (ROOT/p).read_text()
def tree(n):
 if hasattr(n,'low'):return n.low
 if hasattr(n,'prefix'):return (n.prefix,tree(n.node))
 return tuple(tree(x) for x in n.items)
def one(s,p):
 m=lr.match(p,lr.parse(s).forms)
 if len(m)!=1:raise ValueError(p)
 return m[0].node
class Reach(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_exact_existing_face_class_replay(self):
  old=read('tools/fixtures/event-archive-cold-boot-before-reach.lisp');after,count=rw.transform(old)
  self.assertEqual(count,7);self.assertEqual(rw.transform(after),(after,0))
  current=read('books/event-archive-cold-boot.lisp');after=member.boot(visit.explicit(frontier.boot(after),['fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-check-raw','fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-check']))
  for m in lr.match('(defcost ?name ?*body)',lr.parse(after).forms,deep=False):
   p='(defcost '+m.captures['name'].low+' ?*body)'
   self.assertEqual(tree(m.node),tree(one(current,p)))
  self.assertEqual(tree(one(after,'(defun fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-owner-p ?*body)')),tree(one(current,'(defun fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-owner-p ?*body)')))
  for name in ['begin','arm','received','check']:
   p='(defun fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-'+name+' ?*body)'
   self.assertEqual(tree(one(fixed.rewrite(frontier.boot(old)),p)),tree(one(current,p)),name)
 def test_existing_role_policies_preserved_and_new_cold_role_bounded(self):
  old=one(read('tools/fixtures/event-archive-reach-map-state-before.lisp'),'(defun fn2-checkpoint-restore-reach-map-state-p ?*body)')
  current=one(read('books/checkpoint-restore-reach.lisp'),'(defun fn2-checkpoint-restore-reach-map-state-p ?*body)')
  branch=current.items[-1].items[-1]
  self.assertEqual(tree(branch.items[3]),tree(old.items[-1].items[-1]))
  self.assertEqual(tree(branch.items[1]),('equal','role','*fn2-checkpoint-restore-reach-role-event-archive*'))
  self.assertEqual(tree(branch.items[2]),('member-equal','state',('list','*fn2-extent-state-reserved*','*fn2-extent-state-allocated*','*fn2-extent-state-retire-pending*')))
 def test_page_claim_is_after_real_verifier_and_before_parser(self):
  s=read('books/event-archive-cold-reach.lisp')
  f=one(s,'(fn2-event-archive-operation fn2-event-archive-cold-step-reach ?*body)')
  self.assertTrue(lr.match('(if (eq code :ready) ?*body)',[f]))
  gate=lr.match('(fn2-event-archive-reached-page-p ?*args)',[f])[0].node
  step=lr.match('(fn2-event-archive-cold-cursor-step ?*args)',[f])[0].node
  self.assertLess(gate.start,step.start)
  self.assertTrue(lr.match('(equal (fn2-event-archive-source-generation 1 fn2-event-archive) (fn2-checkpoint-restore-reach-control-generation 0 fn2-checkpoint-restore-reach-control))',lr.parse(s).forms))
  h=one(s,'(fn2-event-archive-operation fn2-event-archive-cold-header-reach ?*body)')
  verified=lr.match('(fn2-event-archive-cold-header-step ?*args)',[h])[0].node
  claim=lr.match('(fn2-checkpoint-restore-reach-claim ?*args)',[h])[0].node
  self.assertLess(verified.start,claim.start)
 def test_real_boot_header_guard_and_generation(self):
  s=read('books/event-archive-cold-boot.lisp')
  f=one(s,'(defun fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-header ?*body)')
  self.assertTrue(lr.match('(equal (fn2-machine-phase id fn2-core) *fn2-boot-state-checkpoint-root-verify*)',[f]))
  self.assertTrue(lr.match('(equal (fn2-machine-root-cursor id fn2-core) *fn2-format-page-size*)',[f]))
  self.assertTrue(lr.match('(fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-header-raw fn2-core)',[f]))
  owner=one(s,'(defun fn2-boot-checkpoint-archive-owner-p ?*body)')
  self.assertTrue(lr.match('(fn2-event-archive-cold-reach-current-p ?*args)',[owner]))
if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
